content_sections.heading: Walk-In Procedure
content_sections.text: Candidates who wish to attend the walk-in interview for IIT Indore Yoga Instructor Recruitment 2026 should follow the steps below. Read the official notification carefully before attending the interview. Candidates must report at the venue as per the reporting time mentioned in the notification. Carry all original documents along with one set of self-attested photocopies such as ID proof, educational certificates, experience certificates (if required), and category certificate (if applicable). Bring the duly filled application form if required in the notification. Verify eligibility criteria before attending the interview. Candidates are advised to reach the venue well in advance to complete registration formalities. Keep extra passport-size photographs for submission if required.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to send the advance copy of the application?
faq.answer: The last date to send the advance copy of the application along with the CV and relevant certificates/testimonials is August 12, 2026, by 5:00 PM IST.

faq.question: Q2. When and where is the walk-in interview scheduled?
faq.answer: The walk-in interview is scheduled for August 18, 2026, at 09:00 AM at the Athletics Track, New Sports Arena, IIT Indore, Simrol, Khandwa Road Indore (M.P.).

faq.question: Q3. What is the minimum qualification required for the Yoga Instructor post?
faq.answer: The minimum qualification is XII standard with a Certificate/Level Courses in Sports Coaching from the respective Sports Federation or a Six-week Certificate Course in Sports Coaching from NIS.

faq.question: Q4. What is the salary range for the Yoga Instructor position?
faq.answer: The salary ranges are ₹30,000-40,000 for Junior Coach, ₹45,000-55,000 for Coach, and ₹56,000-65,000 for Senior Coach.

faq.question: Q5. How many vacancies are available for the Yoga Instructor post?
faq.answer: There is one vacancy available for the Yoga Instructor post.

faq.question: Q6. What documents should candidates carry for the walk-in interview?
faq.answer: Candidates should carry their latest CV, filled application form, original documents, and self-attested copies of all relevant documents.

faq.question: Q7. Is there an age limit for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The official notification does not specify any minimum or maximum age limit for any of the posts.

faq.question: Q8. What is the selection process for the Yoga Instructor role?
faq.answer: The selection process includes a Trade Test/Skill test, Certificates Verification, and a Personality Test/Interview.

faq.question: Q9. Can I apply offline for this position?
faq.answer: No, this is a walk-in recruitment. You need to send an advance copy via email and then appear in person for the interview with all required documents.

faq.question: Q10. What is the official website of IIT Indore?
faq.answer: The official website of IIT Indore is www.iiti.ac.in, where you can find more information about the institute and its activities.
